deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'if [ "$AIO_DEPLOYMENT_MODE" = "production" ]; then php artisan aio:production-check; else php artisan aio:production-check || true; fi && (php artisan migrate --force || echo "[WARN] Database migration failed or database not reachable") && php artisan optimize && (php artisan schedule:work > /tmp/aio-scheduler.log 2>&1 &) && exec php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT'
